body.name: Loose recorded-IPW spectral radius
body.construction:
Define
\[
 a^{\mathrm{loose}}_{nm}=
 \sqrt{\frac n{\mu r}}\left[1\wedge
 \frac B{\lambda_{nm}}\left\{
 \sqrt{\frac{(n\vee m)\log(e(n+m))}{q}}+
 \frac{\log(e(n+m))}{q}\right\}\right].
\]
inputs: Dimensions, structural normalization, outcome scale, signal floor, and overlap.
